summary: Aquestive Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing an investor presentation for the H.C. Wainwright 28th Annual Global Investor Conference (Sept 14, 2026) and a press release dated Sept 17, 2026 announcing resubmission of its New Drug Application to the FDA for Anaphylm (dibutepinephrine) sublingual film for Type I allergic reactions including anaphylaxis. No transaction, securities offering, or corporate-control event is present. This is a routine regulatory/clinical milestone disclosure with no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle.
